newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss debt prices gained ground in moderate trading, supported by a rise in U.S. treasuries that followed the release of U.S. producer price data and by an increasing focus on domestic fundamentals, dealers said.

Investors once preoccupied with U.S. interest rate developments were gradually beginning to take a closer look at the very weak domestic economy and the prospect of a further slide in Swiss debt market yields, one Zurich dealer said.
Separately, at the short end of the market, dealers said the Swiss National Bank was adding one-month funds to the money market in the morning at around 1-7/8 percent.
Sept CONF futures CONFU6 up 45 basis points at 114.10
Sept comi medium-term bond COMIU6 up 20 at 110.10.
Sept Euro Swiss francs FESU6 up five at 97.94.
